title: Fix untrappable JSON error in E-Document ADI import (Bug 640122)
summary: E-Document matching assistance import now handles malformed Azure Document Intelligence responses gracefully by checking JSON property existence and adding telemetry for diagnostic purposes instead of crashing with an untrappable error.
key_points: Get calls in GetInnerObject and GetHeaderFields now check the return value before using the token
Missing ADI response properties (outputs, 1, result, fields) no longer cause untrappable runtime errors
Helpers return an empty JsonObject when an expected property is absent
Warning telemetry 0000UK1 to 0000UK4 names the missing property for diagnosis
